frozen_rule.form: predicted y_D = a + b * S1_lodo_D; predicted sign of ln GMR(M_bias, C0_refit) = sign(a + b * S1_lodo_D); predicted gain iff a + b * S1_lodo_D < 0
frozen_rule.fit: OLS over the 11 stored datasets (dataset level), retro/results.json
frozen_rule.slope_sign_note: b < 0: higher S1_lodo predicts a lower log ratio (more gain)

note: computed from the starting-card records only; no refit card or held-out score read
